_about: Hand-authored armour, merged into the generated pack by tools/extract/build_documents.py (apply_manual_content). Put entries under "entries", keyed by name, with the item's system fields. A new name is added, tagged sourcebook "Custom" unless you give one. A name his data already builds is ignored unless the entry says "_override": true, in which case only the fields you give are laid over his. Keys starting with _ are notes and never read. Full guide: docs/ADDING-CONTENT.md. Rebuild with: python tools/extract/build_documents.py --write
